# AI Real Estate Assistant

> Open-source conversational AI platform for property search, analytics, and market insights. Ask in natural language — "2-bedroom apartment in Kraków under 500k" — and get matched listings. Built with FastAPI, Next.js, and ChromaDB. MIT-licensed, free to self-host.

## Capabilities

- Conversational property search with natural language queries
- AI-powered chat interface for property discovery
- Financial tools: mortgage calculator, rent-vs-buy comparison, ROI analysis, TCO calculator
- Interactive maps with clustered property markers and area analytics
- Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) reports
- AI property valuation with multi-year price forecast
- 9 supported languages: English, Polish, Russian, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Ukrainian

## Tech Stack

- **Backend:** FastAPI (Python 3.12+)
- **Frontend:** Next.js 16 + React 19
- **Vector Database:** ChromaDB with MMR reranking
- **LLM Providers:** OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Grok, DeepSeek, local Ollama
- **Database:** PostgreSQL / SQLite
- **Container:** Docker / Docker Compose

## Hosted Version

PropVector AI (https://propvectorai.com) is the hosted version of this project — the same core RAG and vector-search engine, with managed tiers for live data, accounts, AI CRM, and enterprise capabilities. The repository stays open-core; the core engine remains free, while commercial features gate revenue in the hosted product.
